title: ConcordMC
description: ConcordMC - We offer the best Lifesteal and Practice experience in Asia!
body: # 💛 ConcordMC - Asia Region ConcordMC is a community-driven Minecraft network built for players who enjoy competitive survival and fast-paced PvP. Our servers combine the classic Minecraft experience with custom features like Lifesteal mechanics, clans, quests, and a player-driven economy — all without requiring any mods to play. Whether you’re building your base, fighting rivals, grinding resources, or teaming up with friends, ConcordMC offers a polished and active world with constant updates and events. Join thousands of players, form powerful clans, compete in battles, and create your own story on the network. This is a **Java Edition** network that allows all **Bedrock Edition** users to connect and play. ![Lobby](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c81cd819603e42b9d7649d98f64e1702f6cfb03c_0.webp) ## ✨ Server Info We support Minecraft versions 1.21.x – 1.21.11 and are hosted in Asia (Singapore) for the best performance in the region. Our network currently features Lifesteal and Practice gamemodes. - **Version:** 1.21.x - 1.21.11 - **Region:** Asia (Singapore) - **Gamemodes** - Lifesteal - Practice ## 📒 How To Join Join using Minecraft Java Edition. Simply add our server IP to your multiplayer server list and connect to start playing. Bedrock players can also join using our Bedrock IP & Port. - **Java IP:** play.concordmc.net - **Bedrock IP:** bedrock.concordmc.net (19132) ## ❓Help & Support If you need help or experience any issues, please join our [**Discord Server**](https://discord.gg/uZxqEbBx5T) and create a General Support ticket in the #tickets channel. Make sure to include your Minecraft username and a detailed explanation of your problem so our staff can assist you as quickly as possible. A team member will respond once available — your patience is appreciated. 😊
